Players Committee card image of [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' You may not generate more than 2 Force at non-battlegrounds. Ewoks deploy -2 here.

'''Dark Side:''' Force generation here may not be prevented by Objectives.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/endorchiefchirpashut.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/endorchiefchirpashut.png] as of commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs” (31 May 2022).
